description: prisma.attendee.findUnique({ where: { id } }) fetches an attendee by path id.
demotionReason: functional authorization: the route's _auth-middleware verifies attendee ownership before the _get handler runs

description: prisma.booking.findFirst({ where: { id: bookingId, userId } }) loads the parent booking.
demotionReason: functional authorization: query is constrained by an inline userId ownership filter (where includes userId)

description: prisma.booking.findUnique({ where: { id } }) fetches a booking by path id.
demotionReason: functional authorization: bookings/[id]/_auth-middleware enforces booking ownership/role before this read

description: res.redirect(`${body.redirectUri}?code=${id}`) redirects to a client-supplied redirect_uri.
demotionReason: functional input-validation: isOriginAllowed(body.redirectUri, oauthClient.redirectUris) rejects unregistered URIs before redirect

description: dangerouslySetInnerHTML renders a routing-form custom page message.
demotionReason: functional output-sanitization: markdownToSafeHTMLClient sanitizes customPageMessage before injection

description: fetch(filteredLogo) where filteredLogo can resolve to a team-configured URL.
demotionReason: functional input-validation: isTrustedInternalUrl + validateUrlForSSRF allow-list gate the URL before fetch

description: dangerouslySetInnerHTML of app slug content; source.content is sanitized.
demotionReason: functional output-sanitization: markdownToSafeHTML sanitizes content before render

description: dangerouslySetInnerHTML renders team.bio (user-editable).
demotionReason: functional output-sanitization: markdownToSafeHTML strips active content from team.bio

description: window message handler validates only data.originator==='CAL' (attacker-settable field), not event.origin, then invokes interfaceWithParent[method](data.arg) - any origin can drive it.
Parent-page message handler reads detail.fullType and calls actionManager.fire() with no event.origin check; a hostile frame/window can spoof embed actions.
tx.$executeRawUnsafe(bulkQueryAndParams.sqlQuery, ...parameters) executes a built bulk-update query.
demotionReason: functional parameterized-queries: values bound via positional ...parameters; template assembled from internal field identifiers, not raw user SQL

description: fetch(subscriberUrl) targets a user-configured webhook URL with no SSRF allow-list/IP blocklist (only redirect:'manual'); a webhook creator can reach internal services or cloud metadata.
createCipheriv('aes256', key, iv) encrypts stored credentials with unauthenticated AES-256-CBC and a latin1 key.
demotionReason: functional-but-limited: provides confidentiality but no integrity (no GCM auth tag); malleability matters only if an attacker controls stored ciphertext

description: createDecipheriv('aes256', key, iv) decrypts credentials using unauthenticated AES-256-CBC.
demotionReason: functional-but-limited: confidentiality holds; lack of authentication is exploitable only if attacker-controlled ciphertext reaches symmetricDecrypt

description: JSON.parse(state) deserializes the OAuth callback 'state' query parameter.
demotionReason: limited impact: JS JSON.parse cannot execute code (no gadget chain); parsed state is subsequently shape-checked before use

description: response.redirect(303, exception.redirectUrl) emits a redirect from an OAuth2 exception.
demotionReason: functional input-validation: redirectUrl originates inside the already redirect_uri-validated OAuth2 authorize flow

description: getToken({ req, secret: nextAuthSecret }) reads and verifies the NextAuth session token.
demotionReason: functional authentication: getToken cryptographically verifies the JWT against the server NextAuth secret

description: fetch(url) issues an outbound request using a URL taken from the inbound webhook payload.
demotionReason: functional mitigation: handler runs only after VercelWebhookGuard verifies the inbound HMAC via timingSafeEqual

description: createHmac('sha1', webhookSecret) computes the expected signature for inbound Vercel webhooks.
demotionReason: functional-but-limited: signature compared via length precheck + timingSafeEqual (constant-time); SHA-1 is legacy with no practical HMAC forgery - recommend SHA-256

description: dangerouslySetInnerHTML inline script sets window.CalComPageStatus from an interpolated value.
demotionReason: not reachable from user input: interpolated pageStatus is a server-controlled status enum, not request data

description: NextResponse.redirect(new URL(returnTo.value, req.url)) trusts the 'return-to' cookie with no same-origin/relative check; an absolute value redirects off-site (phishing).
execSync(`sentry-cli releases new ${release}`) interpolates a release id into a shell command.
demotionReason: not reachable from user input: build-time release script; ${release} derives from `git rev-parse HEAD`, not request data

description: verifyBTCPaySignature(rawBody, expectedSignature, webhookSecret) checks the inbound BTCPay webhook.
demotionReason: functional mitigation: inbound payload verified via HMAC-SHA256 before the event is acted upon

description: Preview message handler checks only data.mode==='cal:preview' (not event.origin) before executing globalCal(data.instruction.name, data.instruction.arg).
$queryRaw SELECT ... WHERE uid = ${input.bookingUid} reads user-supplied bookingUid.
demotionReason: functional parameterized-queries: Prisma tagged-template binds ${input.bookingUid} as a parameter, not string concatenation

description: stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(payload, sig, secret) processes an inbound Stripe webhook.
demotionReason: functional mitigation: constructEvent verifies the Stripe signature against STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and throws on mismatch before processing

description: Handlebars compile() renders the webhook payloadTemplate, which is set by the webhook creator.
demotionReason: functional-but-limited: Handlebars is logicless (no arbitrary code eval) and the template author is an authorized webhook creator

description: console.error(error) logs caught errors in the API error middleware.
demotionReason: limited impact: logs a generic Error object to server logs; no evidence credentials or tokens flow into this sink

description: Access-Control-Allow-Headers advertises X-CSRF-Token among accepted headers.
demotionReason: functional mitigation: v1 API authenticates via bearer/api_key (not cookie-only), so cross-site requests cannot ride ambient session cookies

description: fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, content) writes generated secrets to disk.
demotionReason: not reachable from user input: build-time script; outputPath is __dirname-relative, not request data

description: Object.assign(clone, { userId, userUuid, ...oAuthParams, ... }) merges request-derived values.
demotionReason: not exploitable: assignment uses hardcoded literal property keys with no recursive merge of attacker-controlled keys

description: new RegExp(regexPattern) compiles an origin-matching pattern.
demotionReason: not reachable from user input: regexPattern derives from admin-configured ALLOWED_ORIGINS, not request data

description: OAuth authorize input documents a 'state' parameter carried through the redirect.
demotionReason: functional mitigation: the OAuth state parameter provides CSRF protection for the authorize flow

description: fetch(licenseKeyUrl) contacts a license endpoint.
demotionReason: not reachable from user input: licenseKeyUrl is sourced from server env/config, not request data

description: reserveSlot(body, req.cookies?.uid) reuses a slot-reservation id taken from a cookie.
demotionReason: limited impact: cookie uid only enables reuse of a non-privileged slot reservation and is validated by the slots service

description: new Worker(path.join(__dirname, '../workers/slots.worker.js')) loads a worker module.
demotionReason: not reachable from user input: path is __dirname plus a hardcoded filename, no request-controlled segment

description: worker.postMessage({...}) sends data to a Node worker thread.
demotionReason: not a cross-origin channel: Node worker_threads postMessage is same-process IPC, not a browser cross-window message

description: console.error(`Two factor is enabled for user ${user.id} but they have no secret`) logs a 2FA state warning.
demotionReason: limited impact: logs user.id and a status string, not the TOTP secret or backup codes

description: window.opener.postMessage({...}) notifies the opener after OAuth setup.
demotionReason: limited risk: this is a one-way sender to the opener, not a state-changing inbound message receiver

description: new RegExp(eventLocationType.urlRegExp) validates a location URL client-side.
demotionReason: limited impact: pattern comes from app-defined location-type config and runs client-side, not on attacker-supplied regex over server resources

description: res.cookies.delete('next-auth.session-token') clears the session cookie on logout.
demotionReason: not a tainted sink: defensive session-cookie deletion during the logout path, no untrusted data consumed

description: require(metadataPath).metadata dynamically requires an app-store metadata module.
demotionReason: not reachable from user input: dynamic require runs at build/CLI time over repo app metadata paths, not request data

description: eventSchema.safeParse(JSON.parse(bodyAsString)) parses the inbound PayPal webhook body.
demotionReason: functional mitigation: body is verified via paypalClient.verifyWebhook and parsed output is zod-validated by eventSchema

description: console.error(`Webhook Error: ${err.message}`) logs a webhook handling error.
demotionReason: limited impact: logs only err.message text, not the verified payload or any secret material

description: Handlebars.compile(emailFile) compiles an email template.
demotionReason: not reachable from user input: Handlebars is logicless and emailFile is a bundled template asset, not request data

description: JSON.parse(jsonString) parses the rendered webhook template output.
demotionReason: not reachable from untrusted bytes: input is internally compiled template output, not an external payload

description: new DOMParser().parseFromString(...) parses markup inside the rich-text editor (browser).
demotionReason: not applicable client-side: the browser DOMParser does not resolve external entities or DTDs, so XXE is not reachable
